references.text: Jesus' warning to the Jews that they cannot go where He is going is repeated here directly to the disciples, with the same wording about their inability to follow.
Here Jesus proclaims the same theme concerning His departure and that people will seek Him but not find Him, concluding that they cannot go where He is.
Jesus confirms that He is going away to prepare a place, and that the disciples will follow where He goes, clarifying the statement that they cannot follow now but will be able to later.
The disciples ask where Jesus is going, and Jesus confirms that they cannot follow Him now, reflecting the situation in 13:33 where He warns them of the same limitation.
